text:
Jordan Lee: hi team — noticed my 401(k) deferral got applied twice this pay period. my stub shows two 6% deferrals. can someone confirm?

Riley (People Ops): yikes. can you paste the paystub lines (redact amounts)? tagging payroll + benefits.

Jordan Lee: redacted: 
```
Pay period: 01/10 - 01/24
Gross Pay: $9,000.00
Earnings:
 - Salary: $9,000.00
Pre-tax Deductions:
 - 401k Deferral (6%): $540.00
 - 401k Deferral (duplicate 6%): $540.00
Employer Match: $540.00 (calculated on single deferral in system?)
Net Pay: $7,380.00
```
I noticed net is lower than expected; not sure if the employer match got calculated correctly.

Payroll Bot: Auto: payrun id pr-91501 completed. Payroll records show two pre-tax deduction lines both mapped to deferral_code: 401K_EMPDEF and 401K_EMPDEF_ALT. Source: benefits_api push created duplicate deduction record when employee updated deferral election via benefits portal at 1951220000; sync job created new deduction line without removing old one. Employer match calc referenced deferral_code: 401K_EMPDEF only.

Tara - Payroll: confirms. looks like a dup deduction record was created by benefits sync when Jordan updated elections this morning; system didn't merge the previous active deduction. Because match calculation references the primary deferral code only, employer match reflected only one deferral (so Jordan got double employee deferral but single match). We'll need to reverse the duplicate deferral and issue a corrective deposit plus ledger adjustments.

Alex (Benefits): thanks for the trace. the benefits portal change event was an election update "increase-to-6" which created a new deduction object instead of editing existing one due to a schema mismatch (portal now sends deduction_key instead of deduction_id). we've reverted the portal change and will patch the sync to perform an upsert. unit tests added.

Riley (People Ops): Jordan — what are remediation options?

Tara - Payroll: options: 1) off-cycle reversal of the duplicate pre-tax deduction (preferred) which will increase net pay and create reversing ledger entries; 2) manually reimburse the employee via AP if off-cycle window is closed (slower). Because payrun pr-91501 transmit is completed (Payroll Bot indicates transmit at 1951233000), we'll still do an off-cycle reversal but need Finance to confirm any deposit implications for pre-tax liabilities (FICA/Medicare unaffected by pre-tax 401k deduction for employee deferral? note: 401k reduces taxable wages for federal income tax but not for FICA).

Payroll Bot: transmit step timestamp: 1951233000.

Alex (Benefits): quick tax note — 401(k) deferrals reduce federal/state taxable wages but not Social Security/Medicare wages; removing duplicate deferral will increase federal taxable wages relative to current stub. We'll ensure YTD taxable wages are adjusted and flag for W-2 review if necessary.

Tara - Payroll: action plan: create off-cycle job pr-91501-rev to reverse duplicate employee deferral (-$540.00), recompute federal tax delta, and issue net adjustment. I'll draft the pre-run stub and post before running. Jordan, you should receive corrected net within 48 hours after run.

Riley (People Ops): Jordan — sorry for the disruption. we'll prioritize. Tara, can you also confirm employer match accounting impact?

Tara - Payroll: employer match was calculated on a single deferral and posted as $540. No change needed to employer match ledger; we'll attach audit note referencing benefits sync bug. Finance, please confirm no additional employer deposit adjustments required.

Payroll Bot: queued off-cycle job pr-91501-rev for 1951234200.

Tara - Payroll: draft off-cycle stub: 
```
Reversal: Duplicate_401k_deferral -$540.00
Tax recalc: Federal Income Tax delta: +$72.00 (reversal changes taxable wages)
Net delta to employee: +$468.00
Notes: reversal for duplicate pre-tax deferral caused by benefits portal sync creating duplicate deduction object. Audit ref pr-91501 -> pr-91501-rev.
```

Alex (Benefits): we'll push the sync patch and a compensating upsert test to staging; releasing after payroll confirms off-cycle.

Tara - Payroll: off-cycle processed at 1951234500. Payment adjustment initiated, ledger reversal posted. Payroll Bot: pr-91501-rev: SUCCESS.

Payroll Bot: Notification: corrected net payment posted to ACH; bank settlement pending.

Jordan Lee: saw pending adjustment in bank portal — thank you. one question: will this change my YTD deferral totals for vesting/plan reporting?

Alex (Benefits): yes — we'll update plan reporting feeds to reflect the reversal so your deferral YTD amount matches payroll ledger. Vesting unaffected. We'll also notify ADP/recordkeeper of the correction via corrected contribution feed.

Riley (People Ops): closing notes: benefits portal sync patch rolled; payroll to attach audit trail and add W-2 review ticket if year-to-date totals change materially. Jordan — closing once bank clears. thanks everyone :thumbsup:

Tara - Payroll: created ticket W2-REVIEW-220 for potential W-2 impact and attached audit refs.

Jordan Lee: much appreciated!
